summary: Plot dimensions, area and road side -> site.json (+ site.svg). Snapshots inputs/.
inputs: inputs/site.json (authoritative, if the client supplied one)

or work/site_trace.json: front_ft, rear_ft, road_side, and the two side lengths by compass (west/east for a road N or S, north/south for a road E or W) or as left_ft / right_ft drawn with the road at the top
checks: road_side in N/E/S/W; sides stored as left/right (road at the top) and by compass
computed area within 1% of the stated area (warn)
front and rear widths within 6 in of each other (warn: typologies assume a regular plot)
manual: If only a sketch / PDF / photo is in inputs/, the agent writes work/site_trace.json (see stages/P1_SITE/TRACE.md) with every guess in assumptions, and shows it to the user before running.
title: Site dimensions, area, road side -> site.json
